text:
Olivia Hart: Heads up — ChannelBridge flagged an Azure Marketplace invoice: they were charged full-month for a plan they downgraded mid-March. They want prorated credit.
Ben Torres: can you share invoice id + change timestamp?
Olivia Hart: invoice INV-AZ-2026-03-5510. downgrade happened 2026-03-12 14:03 UTC. s3://redwood-prod/finance/marketplace/channelbridge/INV-AZ-2026-03-5510.pdf
Azure-Partner-Bot: Marketplace event: subscription_change order 2026-03-12-204 delivered. new_sku=com.channelbridge.basic.monthly, old_sku=com.channelbridge.pro.monthly. Marketplace billing engine billed full month at pro-tier.
Marta G.: quick ledger query: 
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, sku, billed_amount, prorate_flag, change_date
FROM marketplace_invoices
WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-AZ-2026-03-5510';
-- returns billed_amount=1800, prorate_flag=false, change_date=2026-03-12 14:03:12Z
```
Ken Liu: looks like our Azure connector missed the subscription_change webhook that triggers prorate calculation. I see the change event in marketplace events, but the billing pipeline didn't set prorate_flag.
FinanceBot: Reconciliation job RJ-618 flagged invoice mismatch vs expected_prorated_amount. Case RB-9615 created.
Olivia Hart: partner asks for 12 days prorated credit (downgrade on 12th -> 19 days pro, 12 days basic). They provided screenshot of their portal.
Ben Torres: estimate credit = pro_rate_per_day * 12. If pro was $60/mo, basic $40/mo, credit = (60-40) * 12/31 = $7.74 -> round $7.75? seems small, but partner expects correct math.
Marta G.: accounting prefers cents rounding rule: prorate to nearest cent, then sum. I'll draft credit memo CM-2026-03-CB-01 for $7.74. Need approval.
Ken Liu: I'll open INFRA-3184: "azure-connector: ensure subscription_change triggers prorate_flag and recompute invoice" and add a replay job to reprocess affected month.
FinanceBot: INFRA-3184 created and linked to RB-9615. Recommended action: replay_events_for_partner: true.
Olivia Hart: partner requested timeline to see credit before next invoice. can accounting approve expedited small credit?
Marta G.: ACK from accounting channel pending. tagging @acct-pay for approval.
Ben Torres: next steps: 1) approve CM-2026-03-CB-01 2) post credit and notify partner 3) run replay job to fix connector and prevent regression 4) include this in monthly marketplace incident notes.
FinanceBot: RB-9615 status 'investigating'. action_items: ["create_credit_memo","open_infra_bug","replay_events","notify_partner"].
Olivia Hart: Partner replied: thanks for the quick look, they'd like note about fix to avoid future surprises. I'll include that in comms.
Ken Liu: will prioritize INFRA-3184; adding regression test and monitoring alert.
Marta G.: once acct-pay ACKs I'll post CM.
FinanceBot: closing loop reminder set for 2026-03-20.
